source.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Royal Government of Bhutan
source.title: National Budget Report for FY 2026-27
source.table: Annexure B (budget summary), Table 5.3 (sector allocation), Annexure 1 (dzongkhags), Annexure 2 (thromdes), Annexure 3 (gewogs)

notes: The budget report states amounts in millions of Ngultrum; they are stored here in Ngultrum.
The fiscal year runs 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027. Figures are the appropriation approved by Parliament, not actual spending.
“Current” is day-to-day running costs (salaries, operations); “capital” is investment (construction, equipment).
A dzongkhag’s allocation excludes its gewogs and its thromde, which the Ministry budgets separately and which are listed here on their own.

The report prints amounts to three decimals of a million, so a few rows differ by Nu 1,000 from the totals printed beside them (Annexure 1 and the Renewable Natural Resources sector row). That rounding is in the source, not in this transcription.
“Centrally executed” capital is spent on a dzongkhag or gewog by a central agency, not by the local administration itself.
